scope.summary: WP-closeout gate binding the four universal conformance gates (MT-556 determinism, MT-557 parallel-safety, MT-558 visual-verifiability, MT-559 model-invokability) into one [STU-CON-007] pass/fail: the Studio WP MUST NOT close while any of the four gates reports a failing command. Also verifies each per-domain conformance MT (raster MT-021/067, vector, layout MT-190, typography MT-230, color MT-260, effects MT-301, design-system MT-340, prototype MT-386/400, raw MT-432, interop MT-480, automation MT-520, whiteboard MT-540) enumerates all four properties per [STU-CON-007]. Produces the STU-CON-007 conformance report.
acceptance_criteria: WP cannot close while any STU-CON-007 property fails on any command; conformance report produced; per-domain blocks enumerate all four
expected_tests: gate: all four universal conformance gates green across the full command surface; per-domain conformance MTs enumerate all four properties

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: The universal parallel+deterministic+visual+model guarantee not enforced at closeout; operator's core requirement unproven.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
